mode: interactive TUI, permission_mode auto, isolated config, loopback fixture model returning one AskUserQuestion tool_use
note: Field names and relative timing are actual. Session IDs, paths, prompts and tool payloads are omitted; tool_use_id is the fixture model's synthetic value.
findings: PermissionRequest is emitted for AskUserQuestion itself, without tool_use_id; it shares tool_name, tool_input and prompt_id with the preceding PreToolUse.
The ~6 s permission_prompt Notification is emitted for the question dialog and carries no tool name or ID; prompt_id is present.
The question resolves with PostToolUse carrying the original tool_use_id, followed by Stop.
Current HookAdapter maps PreToolUse(AskUserQuestion) to Question but PermissionRequest and permission_prompt to Permission, producing the field-observed Question -> Permission flip.
